candidates: only cut_rank <= 8 (all exported test pairs; candidate_pairs.tsv = these 8 per S1)

France.note: no French labels: the labelled country setting with the higher threshold (India's) is used for France and any other unlabelled country

expected_f_rule: per S1: sort its candidates by score desc; for n = 1..8, TP(n) = sum of top-n scores, T = (sum of all its scores) * (1 + miss_rate), EF(n) = 1.25*TP(n) / (0.25*T + n); P_none = prod(1 - score). If max_n EF(n) > P_none accept the top n_best (smallest n reaching the max), else predict nothing (empty row).
threshold_rule: accept candidates with cut_rank <= 8 and score >= threshold (not used by this submission: every country picked expected_f)
one_owner: after the per-S1 choice, each candidate S2/S3 id is kept only for the S1 where it has the highest score (sort by score desc, unique by candidate, keep first); applied per country, then again across countries
post_processing: none (no rules, no ensembling, no France-specific filters)
chosen_on: half A of 200k held-out training S1 (random halves, numpy default_rng(0)); reported on half B
